title: ಬೆಳಗಿದ ದೀಪಗಳು
author: ಕೆರೂರ ವಾಸುದೇವಾಚಾರ್ಯ
description: ನರಗುಂದದ ಸಾವಿತ್ರೀಬಾಯಿ, ದೇವಲದೇವಿ, ನೂರಜಹಾನ, ಶಿಕಂದರ, ಮಹಾರಾಣಾ ಪ್ರತಾಪಸಿಂಹ, ರಾಸಪುಟಿನ, ಪಿಝಾರೋ — ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಕಾಲ ದೇಶಗಳ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕುರಿತು ಕೆರೂರ ವಾಸುದೇವಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ತಮ್ಮ ‘ಸಚಿತ್ರ ಭಾರತ’ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಚಾರಿತ್ರಿಕ ಕಥೆಗಳು. ಅವರು ತೀರಿಕೊಂಡ ಮೂವತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಬಳಿಕ ೧೯೫೨ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದ ಈ ಸಂಕಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶೌರ್ಯ, ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ದುರಾಸೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಹಳೆಯ ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸೊಗಸಾದ ಗದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಡಿವೆ.

provenance.licenseNote: Kerur Vasudevacharya (ಕೆರೂರ ವಾಸುದೇವಾಚಾರ್ಯ, 1866–1921) died in 1921 (Library of Congress Name Authority File n83129153, heading 'Vāsudēvācārya, Ke., 1866-1921', https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n83129153; Kannada Wikipedia ಕೆರೂರು ವಾಸುದೇವಾಚಾರ್ಯ, 'ನಿಧನ: ೧೯೨೧'; also the University of Wisconsin Indian Theater catalogue, 'Vāsudēvācārya, Kerūr, 1866-1921'; the 1952 book itself calls him ದಿವಂಗತ. Wikidata Q140299202 gives 1961-05-17, which would also be before 1966), so the work is public domain in India (life + 60). Text is the Kannada Wikisource transcription of the posthumous first edition (April 1952, ವಾಸುದೇವ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯರತ್ನ ಮಾಲೆ ೬ / ಮನೋಹರ ಗ್ರಂಥಮಾಲೆ ೧೧೩, publisher ಧೀರೇಂದ್ರ ವಾಸುದೇವಾಚಾರ್ಯ ಕೆರೂರ, ed. ಜಿ. ಬಿ. ಜೋಶಿ, Karnataka Printing Works, Dharwad), scanned as ಪರಿವಿಡಿ:ಬೆಳಗಿದ ದೀಪಗಳು.pdf; the nine stories were written by Kerur and first printed in his magazine ಸಚಿತ್ರ ಭಾರತ before 1921, and the 1952 volume is only a minimal compilation of them by his son and G. B. Joshi (died 1993). Only Kerur's nine stories were taken: the portrait, title and imprint pages, the son's ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕರ ಮಾತು, Joshi's ಅರಿಕೆ, the contents, the advertisement page, running heads, page numbers, signature marks, ornaments and section rules, and three English glosses in Latin letters were dropped. Every story page (scans 11–180; quality 4 'validated' except 15 and 17 at quality 3) was proofread against the scan images 2026-11-02/03 and set to the printed reading: about 2,200 OCR word errors corrected, about 60 dropped words, lines and page-edge fragments restored, paragraphs re-joined across print-line and page breaks; the author's spelling is kept, and only plain misprints of the 1952 print were corrected and missing full stops supplied, all listed one by one in sources.txt beside this file.

alt.en: Portrait of Kerur Vasudevacharya, from the 1952 edition of Belagida Deepagalu

provenance.licenseNote: Portrait photograph of Kerur Vasudevacharya (1866–1921) printed as the frontispiece (page 1) of the scanned first edition of ಬೆಳಗಿದ ದೀಪಗಳು (Dharwad, April 1952; Kannada Wikisource file "ಬೆಳಗಿದ ದೀಪಗಳು.pdf"). Public domain in India: copyright in a photograph expires 60 years after publication (Copyright Act 1957, s. 25); the photograph was taken in the author's lifetime (before 1921) and was published by 1952 at the latest, so it expired at the end of 2012 at the latest; photographer unknown. Cropped to 3:4, the printing halftone smoothed, resized to 480×640 and stored as a warm monochrome (duotone) version for the shelf; nothing else changed.
